highlights.description: Machine-readable framework for telling the platform story: how engineering best practices are Standardized, Consumed, Automated, Leveraged, and made Effective

added.description: Core SCALE types: Framework, Domain, Capability, Metric, Assessment, NarrativeBlock
MaturityLadder mapping observed values to PRISM maturity levels (1-5) with threshold rungs, exclusive comparisons, and direction-aware logic
Weakest-link maturity semantics: capability maturity = min(metric rungs), domain maturity = min(capability rungs)
ComputeRollup for attainment calculation with domain aspect scores as plain means
CompareRollups for period-over-period deltas and movers layer
ExternalModel for codifying third-party maturity models (AWS, New Relic) as data with PRISM crosswalks
LoadFrameworkDir assembling framework.json + domains/*.json + external/*.json
Validate enforcing unique metric IDs, SCALE aspect requirements, and ladder constraints
JSON schema generation from Go types via invopop/jsonschema
Embedded schemas: scale-framework, scale-domain, scale-assessment, scale-external-model
Reference catalog with three domains: api, observability, security
Two external models: AWS Observability Maturity, New Relic Observability Maturity
Self-contained HTML story report with aspect tiles, movers, domain journeys, and capability maturity chips
External model lens view for rendering through vendor maturity ladders
Light/dark theme support in HTML reports with no external assets
CLI: scale validate, report, and export subcommands
<scale-report> Lit web component rendering story report client-side from JSON IR
compute.js mirroring Go rollup/maturity semantics, pinned by node tests
Themeable web component via --scale-* CSS custom properties
Example assessments (Q2/Q3) and generated reports (aspect, AWS, New Relic)

documentation.description: README documenting SCALE framework: five aspects, information model, rollup semantics, CLI usage

build.description: GitHub Actions workflows: go-ci, go-lint, go-sast-codeql
